leave_rights_statement.title: Leave: rights statement on decisions
leave_rights_statement.text: If you disagree with this decision, you can discuss it with your manager or HR. Refusing a request does not affect any minimum leave entitlement you have under the law.

sickness_evidence_reminder.title: Sick leave: evidence reminder
sickness_evidence_reminder.text: If your absence continues, we may ask for evidence of your sickness in line with our Sick Leave Policy.

_note: Prompt 3 clauses. Mandatory clauses in no_starter_text block preflight until a jurisdiction clause is released; optional ones are simply omitted until one exists. Starters never invent entitlements, amounts, limits or notice periods.
